_readme: Octopus tool registry. A tool is something an agent can be given: a set of capabilities plus (eventually) an MCP server.
Re-read whenever this file changes - edit and save, no restart.
agents.json says which tools an agent MAY ever get; this file says when a request NEEDS one, so a task is only
given the tools it uses (a writing request gets none, a coding request gets filesystem + git + terminal, ...).
kind          builtin = works today (Claude Code's own tools, or Octopus's own code)
mcp     = provided by an MCP server; needs 'mcp' filled in and 'enabled' set to true
enabled       false = never selected, whatever the request says
capabilities  what the tool can do, as capability names from assistant/capabilities.py. The plan shows their policies,
and the strictest one decides whether the plan needs your OK
when          categories: always selected for these request categories
keywords:   selected when the request matches any of these regular expressions (case-insensitive)
mcp           {"command": "npx", "args": [...], "env": {...}} - the MCP server to attach. Not used until the agent lane
passes it to Claude Code (--mcp-config); kept here so adding a server is a data change, not a code change

tools.label: Filesystem
tools.description: Read and edit files inside the selected project.

tools.label: Git
tools.description: Inspect history and make local commits and branches.

tools.label: Terminal
tools.description: Run shell commands: tests, builds, linters, scripts. Every command still goes through the approval rules.

tools.label: GitHub
tools.description: Push branches and work with pull requests and issues (through git and the gh CLI).

tools.label: Salesforce
tools.description: Salesforce DX / the sf CLI: metadata, Apex, LWC, orgs.

tools.label: Web / Search
tools.description: Search the web and read pages.

tools.label: Browser
tools.description: Drive a real browser (open pages, click, fill forms). Not connected yet.

tools.label: Database
tools.description: Query and change a database. Not connected yet.

tools.label: Google Drive
tools.description: Find and read files in Google Drive. Not connected yet.

tools.label: Slack
tools.description: Read and post Slack messages. Not connected yet.

tools.label: Image generation
tools.description: Ask an image model for a picture.

tools.label: Gmail
tools.description: Search, read, draft and (with your OK) send email from your connected Google account.

tools.label: Calendar
tools.description: Read your calendar, check availability, create and change events.

tools.label: Reminders
tools.description: Set, list and cancel reminders that ping your phone.

tools.label: Hand off to Coding Agent
tools.description: Queue a Claude Code task in one of your projects from a personal-assistant request.

tools.label: Octopus workspace
tools.description: Octopus's own queue, projects and backlog: status, stop, continue, add to backlog.

tools.label: AI models
tools.description: Let the Personal Assistant hand a piece of writing, a web-grounded answer or an image to the app's own models (models.json).
